statements.text: Adopting panpsychism is not giving up on a scientific explanation of consciousness. It proposes a different program: explain the complex consciousness of humans and animals by simpler forms of consciousness postulated in simpler matter, much as electromagnetism was explained by postulating new fundamental properties.

sources.quote: panpsychism is a scientific research programme in its own right
try to explain the complex consciousness of humans and other animals in terms of simpler forms of consciousness which are postulated to exist in simpler forms of matter
